Run 42702557548 at 7e0a82c passed 14,888/14,888 and exported: the untouched 168-row holdout of gamma_lower_q/HOLDOUT_DESIGN.md (7 new shapes, seam at A + 1, Gamma and Chi-square, P and Q) passes H1 to H4, worst survival 8.0E-17, cumulative 7.8E-17, 84/84 routes bit-identical; the re-exported fitting ladder passes L1 and L2, worst survival 8.9E-17 (was 1.6E-9); 22 promoted X = 0.5 main-grid rows match the model, worst 7.8E-17. The binary64 fallback at the pair's cap still forms the complement only above A of about 1.07E8, where it cannot amplify; documented and asserted. No contract relaxed; 166/166 main, 83/83 holdout; 27-row coverage debt unchanged. Results in gamma_lower_q/PREDICTIONS.md.

resolution.evidence: Maintainer explicitly accepted the results reached and closed #307 on 2026-11-11 with further optimization/ultrafast routing deferred. Exact LogGamma reuse is integrated via #313/#315 (8.5–12x repeated shape-100 P/Q and 2.2–2.5x cold inverse gains; cold forward mixed). B5 is retained as an unpromoted prototype: run 43070672334 at e498658 passed 576 arithmetic checks, 11 normalization checks, 1371 exact inputs and 48 timing rows, reducing warm pair cost versus B4 by 21.5–82.9%. It is not deployed in public functions and does not meet the 100-us target. Ordinary regression 43070683108 attempt 2 passed. The 100-us binary64 fit target is not a universal DD release gate; no frozen protocol, accuracy threshold or recorded result is changed. B5 promotion and the untouched 117-point routing holdout remain deferred. See docs/research/GAMMA_PERFORMANCE_STATUS.md and retained evidence docs/research/gamma_scalar_evidence/run_43070672334/. Other release blockers remain open.
